requirement_satisfaction.criteria: Fraction of required outputs (scene_breakdown, character_objectives, acoustic_constraints, explicit_unknowns) fully addressed.

source_fidelity.criteria: Adherence to authorized character traits, setting physics, and avoidance of forbidden assumptions (e.g. no traitor Marcus).

continuity.criteria: 1 if persistent state/context connects seamlessly across scene transitions; 0 if state is dropped or re-invented.

useful_novelty.criteria: Generation of creative, plausible details within constraints without hallucinating ungrounded entities.

correction_burden.criteria: Number of human/evaluator interventions needed to fix canon violations, structural omissions, or forbidden assumptions.

reconstruction_burden.criteria: Number of manual context reconstruction steps needed to resume or continue the brief.

execution_overhead.criteria: Relative operational overhead in terms of state machinery, mediation steps, and storage writes.

recovery.criteria: 1 if able to recover gracefully from missing inputs or simulated interruption; 0 otherwise.

forbidden_bias: No condition is pre-ordained to win. Evaluator G must score raw outputs without condition labels.
